compos.text: Map of the San Francisco area with various location markers. The markers are color-coded, with some in purple and others in gray. The map includes labels for areas such as San Francisco, Daly City, Millbrae, and Linda Mar. There are zoom in and zoom out buttons at the bottom right corner, and a navigation icon at the bottom left corner.

Alt text: "Smartphone status bar showing various icons. From left to right: signal strength, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, battery level, multiple Facebook notifications, 'ET' notifications, location services enabled, Wi-Fi connected, and the current time displayed as 10:38."
Alt text: "Back arrow icon indicating a navigation option to go back to the previous screen."

compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen displays a map of the San Francisco area with various markers. The markers are color-coded, with some being purple and others gray. These markers likely represent specific locations or points of interest. 

At the top of the screen, there is a status bar showing the time (10:38) and various icons indicating notifications, signal strength, battery level, and other system statuses.

At the bottom of the screen, there are three navigation buttons:
1. A back arrow button on the left.
2. A home button in the center.
3. A recent apps button on the right.

Additionally, there are two floating action buttons on the map:
1. A compass icon in the bottom left corner, likely for re-centering the map to the user's current location.
2. A magnifying glass icon in the bottom right corner, likely for searching locations on the map.
